about.heading: How it works
steps: Pick a package and a date
Each departure is one 6-seat vehicle group. See seats and members before you join.
7 questions and optional MBTI rank groups by fit. Optional, but recommended.
Pay only the flight portion first
Pay the deposit (flight cost) via Toss Payments and your seat is confirmed.
Pick card installments at Toss if you like. We charge no interest or fees.
If the minimum is reached 14 days before departure the trip is confirmed; otherwise move the date or get a full refund.
refundRows: Deposit refunded minus airline rules, remainder in full
Reminders on D+0 and D+3, then seat released; deposit rules apply
faqs: Most people do. That's what companion matching is for.
Korean passports enter visa-free (as of 2026; re-check before departure).
Yes, every departure has a Korean-speaking guide.
Check the 'camps with showers' note on the itinerary. Some Gobi stretches have none for ~2 days.
All payments go through Toss Payments. Card details are entered at Toss only.
